evidence: The two precursors used were H2S, which was generated in situ in the precursor source cylinder via the thermal decomposition of thioacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, U.S.A.), and diethylzinc (DEZ) (Sigma-Aldrich, U.S.A.). The pulsing conditions consisted of 0.25-s H2S pulses, 0.1-s DEZ pulses, and 60-s He purges.
